summary: REQ-1 is only partially met: a visible Login/Logout control was added to the global header, but the Login control triggers Internet Identity login directly rather than navigating to /login as requested. The Home page now includes a prominent Login CTA that navigates to /login when unauthenticated. REQ-2 appears implemented in the header (Admin link visibility for authenticated admins) and admin hooks/page were adjusted, but the diff is truncated so full verification of the Awaiting Approval tab behavior and access-denied/login-prompt states is limited.

missing_requirements.requirement: Header must show a "Login" button/link when logged out that navigates to /login.
missing_requirements.reason: The header Login control calls `handleAuth`, which invokes `login()` (Internet Identity) directly instead of navigating to `/login`.

hallucinated_features.description: Header Login/Logout button performs authentication directly (calls Internet Identity login/clear) and includes a special-case retry workaround for 'User is already authenticated', plus clears the React Query cache on logout.
hallucinated_features.reason: The request asked for a Login control that navigates to `/login` and a Logout action; it did not request direct auth handling in the header, error-retry logic, or clearing the entire query cache.
